name: What utilities are needed for a foundation-based tiny home?
description: Foundation-based tiny homes require standard utilities: electricity, potable water, and a connection to either a municipal sewer or a septic system.

mainEntity.name: What utilities are needed for a foundation-based tiny home?

acceptedAnswer.text: A foundation-based tiny home requires the same essential utilities as a standard house: electricity, water, and sewer or septic systems. Electricity provides power for lighting, appliances, and heating/cooling. A potable water supply is necessary for drinking, bathing, and cooking. Wastewater removal typically involves connecting to a municipal sewer line or installing a septic system, depending on the property's location and available infrastructure. Proper utility hookups are critical for habitability and must comply with local codes and safety standards.
acceptedAnswer.description: Foundation-based tiny homes require standard utilities: electricity, potable water, and a connection to either a municipal sewer or a septic system.
